lessons_used: Predictions consistently overstated gains overall, though several unexpected winning updates (including copy, hint, and redesign changes) performed better than predicted.

Evidence is still thin for adoption wait_info, choose_path hint, choose_path redesign, finish copy, finish notification, home hint, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout, and sign_in new_flow because each has only 1 test.
Interactive finish flows (finish new_flow) remained effective, winning in 4 of 6 tests (+9.4%, +5.7%, +4.3%, and +4.4%).
Home wait_info changes were helpful in 2 of 7 tests (+4.2% and +4.0%), while the remaining 5 showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign consistently hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
No clear effect was seen across tests for adoption copy, choose_path layout, choose_path reorder, finish new_screen, home notification, sign_in hint, and sign_in notification.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Calling Practice Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive mini-practice element on the final screen where users try calling and hiding their pet before launching to the desktop.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple inquiries after setup regarding how to show, hide, or talk to the pet on the desktop, and interactive finish flows show strong historic test wins.

components.text: Try pressing the shortcut key to hide or summon your companion right now.

guard.reason: Adds interactive guidance components to the home intro step without breaking any onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Interactive finish flows have high historical win rate (+3.5% avg, up to +9.4%), backed by support requests on pet controls, though requires new UI flow.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Creation Stage Status Monitor
candidates.change: Displays active stage progress steps and rendering activity updates while the desktop pet is generating in the background.
candidates.why: Home step wait time is the longest in the funnel (mean 2336s), and structured wait_info updates on the waiting screen have previously delivered positive retention gains.

waiting.headline: Creating Your Desktop Companion
waiting.body: Your pet is being rendered and prepared for your desktop display.

guard.reason: Enhances waiting screen progress info while retaining the screen's core job of showing pet creation.

candidates.score_note: Home step has low drop-off (9.4%) but high mean wait time (2336s). Home wait_info historic lift is modest (+1.7%).

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Quick Command Summary Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the home intro screen into a split layout featuring interactive control icons and command key cheat-sheet cards.
candidates.why: Support mail highlights post-onboarding confusion around controlling and hiding the desktop pet, while redesigning the finish view clarifies key interactions.

guard.reason: replacement for 'home_intro.home_welcome' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'] with real words

candidates.title: Account Persistence Verification Card Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the sign-in step with a compact card layout emphasizing cloud account persistence and existing pet recovery.
candidates.why: Eight support complaints reported missing or reset pets after signing in again, and 23% of users drop off during sign_in.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep Your Desktop Pet Safe
sign_in.body: Link your account now so your pet and customization progress are saved securely in the cloud.

guard.reason: replacement for 'sign_in.sign_in_options' does not do the job (a sign-in button that says so): needs 1 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Interactive Path Style Preference Quiz Flow
candidates.change: Adds interactive quick-choice cards on the path selection screen to help users instantly choose between active or calm pet behaviors.
candidates.why: Although choose_path has an 86.2% conversion, the mean time spent is 514s; providing interactive quick choices helps guide prompt decision making.

guard.reason: Adds companion play style preference cards to choose_path without removing path selection options.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path already converts high at 86.2% with no direct support mail evidence; new interactive quiz flow carries development cost.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Trait Confirmation Flow
candidates.change: Introduces an interactive trait confirmation preview on the adoption certificate screen where users toggle companion personality tags.
candidates.why: The adoption stage suffers the largest funnel drop-off (67.2% conversion, mean 1017s), and adding active confirmation increases user attachment.

guard.reason: Adds trait confirmation controls to adoption certificate without removing the certificate or stamp.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has the biggest funnel drop-off (67.2% conversion), but new flows on adoption carry high implementation cost and mixed historical adoption results.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Voice Tuning Practice Flow
candidates.change: Adds an audio sample player component to the waiting screen allowing users to test pet chirps and voice sounds while waiting.
candidates.why: Waiting during pet generation takes significant time (median 201s), and interactive wait flows reduce perceived waiting friction.

guard.reason: Adds a sound test feature to the waiting screen while keeping creation feedback intact.

candidates.score_note: Home new_flow shows steady +1.9% historical gain and helps fill long wait time, though home drop-off rate is relatively low.

candidates.title: Desktop Summon and Visibility Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Displays a clear hint on the finish screen explaining how to bring the pet back if hidden or minimized.
candidates.why: Multiple support tickets mentioned post-onboarding confusion regarding hiding and bringing back the pet on the screen.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Press your assigned shortcut or click the system tray icon anytime to bring your pet to the front.

guard.reason: Adds helpful shortcut guidance to home_intro within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Addresses explicit support issues post-setup with simple config-only hint change, though finish drop-off is already small (9.6%).

candidates.title: Cloud Pet Account Preservation Status Info
candidates.change: Adds clear hint copy and account state information on sign_in clarifying that logging in retains pet data across reinstalls.
candidates.why: The top support theme (8 emails) involved lost or reset pets upon signing back in, making account persistence explicit at sign_in crucial.

sign_in.hint: Your pet customization and companion history automatically sync with this sign-in account.

guard.reason: Adds informative account sync hint to sign_in without altering sign-in options or rules.

candidates.score_note: Sign_in drops 23% of users and represents the #1 support issue (8 emails); low implementation cost via text/info update.

candidates.title: Custom Photo Quality Verification Checklist Info
candidates.change: Displays a photo clarity checklist on the photo upload screen to help users upload compatible pet images.
candidates.why: Three support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected pet appearances during adoption photo setup.

upload_photos.hint: For best results, upload bright, well-lit photos with your pet centered in the frame.

guard.reason: Adds framing checklist and hint to photo upload screen without altering its job or options.

candidates.score_note: Targets the highest drop-off step (adoption, 67.2%), aligned with support tickets and supported by strong initial adoption wait_info data (+5.2%).
